calls.video_title: I Just Invested €1,000 in THESE 4 Stocks! (October 2026)
calls.thesis: Adding 10 shares (50 -> 60, ~€231): ~4% dividend yield plus 5-6% buybacks = ~10% payout; net cash covers 70% of market cap, so the operating business is bought for ~30% of the price.
calls.base_case: Normal: ~5%/yr growth 10y, fair P/E ~13 -> fair price >$50 (more than double).
calls.bear_case: Negative: earnings -10%/yr 5y then flat, fair P/E 7.8 -> fair value $33, still ~6%/yr average return.
